children: Overview
Canada enterprise software maker's fiscal Q2 revenue rose 26% yr/yr to $163.3 mln
Adjusted net income for fiscal Q2 increased 79% yr/yr to $43.2 mln
QNX segment revenue grew 27% yr/yr, driven by automotive and embedded markets
Outlook
BlackBerry sees Q3 revenue of $143 mln to $154 mln
Company expects FY27 revenue of $616 mln to $636 mln
BlackBerry forecasts Q3 adjusted EPS of $0.04 to $0.05
Result Drivers
QNX SEGMENT GROWTH - Co said QNX revenue rose 27% yr/yr, driven by strength in core automotive business and embedded markets
MAJOR DESIGN WIN - Alloy Kore design win, largest in QNX history, added over $100 mln to QNX royalty backlog
SECURE COMMUNICATIONS STABILITY - Secure Communications remained a stable and profitable contributor following a particularly strong first quarter
